1. GENERAL CUSTOMER SERVICE FRAMEWORK
Aura Retail Enterprises is committed to providing consistent, clear, and efficient customer service. This Knowledge
Base serves as the definitive reference document for customer support interactions, defining mandatory
operational parameters, resolution frameworks, policy boundaries, and standard procedures. 1.1 Customer Communication Standards
All representative communications—whether human or automated AI systems—must observe the following
communication rules:
Tone and Manner: Maintain a professional, polite, empathetic, and objective tone at all times.

2.1 Standard & Express Shipping Schedules
Aura Retail processes and dispatches orders Monday through Friday, excluding public holidays. Orders placed after
2:00 PM EST will begin processing on the following business day.

2.2 Order Processing Timelines
Standard processing requires 24 to 48 hours prior to carrier handover. During peak promotional periods or
holidays, processing may extend up to 72 hours. Processing times are distinct from carrier transit times. IMPORTANT POLICY NOTE FOR SUPPORT AGENTS

2. SHIPPING, DELIVERY & FULFILLMENT POLICIES (CONTINUED)
2.3 Lost, Delayed, or Stolen Shipments
If a customer reports a missing package, agents must apply the following resolution workflows based on carrier
status:
In-Transit Delay: If a package has shown no tracking updates for 5 consecutive business days (domestic) or
10 business days (international), initiate a carrier trace request. Marked Delivered but Not Received: Instruct the customer to verify household members, building
reception, and immediate delivery areas. Customers must wait 48 hours from the timestamp of delivery before
initiating a formal inquiry, as carriers occasionally pre-scan packages. Confirmed Lost or Stolen: If an item is unlocated 48 hours post-delivery timestamp, or if the carrier
confirms non-delivery, open an internal claim.

Address adjustments can only be executed while an order status remains in "Pending" or "Processing". Once an
order progresses to "Shipped" or "In Transit", address rerouting cannot be guaranteed. Rerouting via carrier
intercept incurs a standard $15.00 fee charged to the customer. 3. RETURN, EXCHANGE & REFUND POLICIES
3.1 Standard Return Eligibility
Aura Retail provides a 30-day return window starting from the documented date of carrier delivery. To qualify for a
return, items must satisfy the following parameters:
Unused, unworn, and unwashed condition with all original tags attached. Returned in original product packaging containing all included accessories, manuals, and collateral.

The following categories are strictly excluded from standard return and refund eligibility unless defective upon
receipt:
Final Sale / Clearance merchandise marked as non-returnable. Perishable goods, personal care items, hygiene products, and undergarments. Digital download codes, software licenses, or redeemed gift cards. Customized or personalized print-on-demand items.

3. RETURN, EXCHANGE & REFUND POLICIES (CONTINUED)
3.3 Refund Processing Framework
Upon receipt of returned merchandise at our centralized distribution facility, inspection takes between 3 to 5
business days. Once inspected and approved, refunds are processed according to the following guidelines:
Credit/Debit Card Refunds: Require 5 to 10 financial business days to reflect on customer bank statements
following authorization. Store Credit & Gift Cards: Issued within 24 hours of return approval and sent directly to the customer's
registered email address. Original Shipping Fees: Non-refundable for standard returns unless the return is due to corporate error or
defective merchandise.

3.4 Exchange Workflow
Customers desiring a different size, color, or model may elect an instant exchange or standard exchange:
Standard Exchange: The replacement item is shipped upon receipt and verification of the original item at
our facility. Instant Exchange: A temporary hold is placed on the customer's payment method for the cost of the new
item. The replacement item ships immediately. The hold is released once the returned merchandise is scanned
into carrier transit within 14 calendar days. 4. ORDER CANCELLATIONS & MODIFICATIONS
4.1 Cancellation Window
Orders may be canceled without charge within 60 minutes of submission. Due to automated fulfillment workflows,
cancellation requests received after 60 minutes cannot be guaranteed, as orders quickly enter warehouse packing
queues.

If an order has entered "Packing" or "Manifested" status, agents must advise the customer that the order will
complete shipment, and direct them to use the automated returns portal upon delivery. 4.2 Item Additions & Quantity Changes
Once an order is successfully placed, items cannot be added to the existing transaction ID due to payment security
compliance (PCI-DSS). Customers must place a secondary order for additional items. Quantity reductions or
single-item removals are permissible if executed prior to warehouse fulfillment. 5. PRODUCT WARRANTIES & REPAIRS
5.1 Limited Manufacturer Warranty
All standard electronic and manufactured hardware products sold by Aura Retail carry a 1-Year Limited
Manufacturer Warranty covering defects in materials and workmanship starting from the original purchase date.

6. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQ) — ORDERS & ACCOUNT
MANAGEMENT
Q1: How can I check the current status of my order? Customers can check order status by providing their Order ID and billing zip code through our self-service web portal, or
by asking our support agent. Statuses include: Pending, Processing, Shipped, Delivered, or On Hold. Q2: Why is my order marked as "On Hold"? An "On Hold" status usually indicates a payment verification review, an incomplete delivery address, or an item inventory
stock check. Agents should verify account verification details before releasing the hold. Q3: Can I update my payment method after placing an order? No. For security purposes, payment methods cannot be altered post-checkout. If payment fails, the order will
automatically cancel within 2 hours, and a new order must be placed. Q4: What should I do if I received a wrong item?

automatically cancel within 2 hours, and a new order must be placed. Q4: What should I do if I received a wrong item?
If an incorrect item was received, please contact support with your Order ID and a photo of the received item and packing
slip. A prepaid return label and replacement order will be dispatched immediately at no additional cost. Q5: Can I split shipment of my order to multiple addresses? A single order cannot be split across multiple delivery destinations. Separate orders must be placed for each distinct
shipping address. Q6: How do I apply a discount promo code after an order has been submitted? Promo codes must be applied during checkout. However, support agents are authorized to retroactively apply valid
single-use discount codes if requested within 24 hours of order placement. Q7: Why was my order canceled automatically? Automatic cancellations occur primarily due to failed payment authorizations, address validation failures, or unexpected
inventory stockouts.

7. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQ) — SHIPPING & DELIVERY
Q10: Do you ship to P.O. Boxes or APO/FPO addresses? Yes, we ship to P.O. Boxes and military APO/FPO locations using USPS Standard Ground service exclusively. Express
shipping options are unavailable for P.O. Box addresses. Q11: What occurs if I am not at home during a delivery attempt? Carriers will make up to three delivery attempts. If unsuccessful, the package will be held at a local carrier hub for 5
business days before being returned to sender. Q12: Are customs duties and taxes included for international shipments? For DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) countries selected at checkout, duties are calculated and prepaid. For DDU (Delivered
Duty Unpaid) destinations, local customs duties and taxes must be settled by the customer upon arrival. Q13: My tracking shows "Delivered," but I cannot locate my package. What should I do?

Check surrounding doors, garage areas, and neighbors. Wait 48 hours as delivery scans can occasionally precede physical
drop-off. If still missing after 48 hours, contact support to open a trace claim. Q14: How long does express delivery take if I order on Friday evening? Orders placed after 2:00 PM EST on Friday are processed on Monday morning. Express 2-day delivery placed Friday

local hold at an authorized pickup station. Q16: Why has my tracking status not updated in several days? Tracking pauses can occur during long-haul transit between sorting hubs. If tracking remains unupdated for more than 5
consecutive business days, support can initiate a carrier search.

8. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQ) — RETURNS, REFUNDS &
REPAIRS
Q18: How do I generate a prepaid return shipping label? Visit our self-service returns page at aura-retail.com/returns, enter your Order ID and billing zip code, select the items
being returned, and print the pre-addressed return shipping label. Q19: Can I return an online order to a physical store location? Yes. Items purchased online may be returned to any official Aura Retail store within 30 days, accompanied by order
confirmation documentation and a valid government ID. Q20: How long does it take for a refund to reflect on my bank account? Once our warehouse inspects the return (3-5 business days), refunds take an additional 5-10 business days depending on
your financial institution's processing times. Q21: Are return shipping fees covered for international returns?

International return shipping costs are the responsibility of the customer unless the return is due to a documented
product defect or fulfillment error. Q22: What happens if I return an item after the 30-day return window? Returns received between 31 and 60 days from delivery are subject to a 15% restocking fee and issued as store credit only. Returns past 60 days are rejected and sent back to sender. Q23: How are bundled item returns processed? When returning an item purchased as part of a promotional bundle, all bundled items must be returned together to
receive a full refund. Partial bundle returns forfeit bundled discounts. Q24: What documentation is needed to file a warranty claim? Warranty claims require the original Order ID, serial number (if applicable), description of the defect, and clear
photographic or video evidence of the issue.

Support agents must adhere to strict security guidelines to ensure customer privacy compliance:
PCI-DSS Compliance: Never request or record complete 16-digit credit card numbers, CVV codes, or online
banking passwords in chat logs or tickets. PII Handling: Customer addresses, emails, and phone numbers must only be accessed for legitimate
fulfillment or verification purposes. Identity Verification: Before modifying order parameters, verify at least two matching data points (e.g.,
Order ID + Billing Zip Code).
